Contribution table

Source: R/report.R
contribution_table.Rd

One row per outcome and disease with raw and adjusted impacts, the disease's burden (Shapley share of the expected loss, including any interaction share) and, if economics is given, the attributed gap and its monetary value.

Usage

contribution_table(result, economics = NULL)

Arguments

result

A deconflate() result.

economics

Optional list with observed and unit_value (see value_losses()).

Value

A data frame.

Examples

contribution_table(deconflate(example_uk_dairy_2022(), method = "published"),
                   uk_dairy_2022_economics())
